triggers.description:
Set of outputs that triggers the child rule. The parent must complete with one of
the outputs in this array in order to run the rule this dependency is associated with.

parentRule.description: It represents the child dependency, with to a parent.

title: Type to define conditional edge (based on triggers) from a parent to a child that represent a Directed acyclic graph (DAG).
name: DataValidationRuleDependency
